method: conditional multinomial softmax with log normalized inverse decision-time odds offset
features: 90 ordered lane-pair indicators in position pairs (0,1),(0,2),(1,2), enumerated first lane then distinct second lane
clipped log incumbent/market ratio divided by 5
18 position-lane indicators multiplied by clipped log market position marginal divided by 5
objective: mean multiclass negative log likelihood plus l2/2 * squared weight norm
selection: minimum Oct17 validation mean NLL including exact zero-residual market; tie within 1e-10 favors market then larger l2. Save best nonzero candidate separately even if market wins. Refit chosen nonzero l2 on Oct14-17 once. No further variants.
test: Oct18 already inspected in prior research, retrospective only. Do not open test outcomes before artifact freeze. No test-driven model or policy changes.
uncertainty: Original probStd unchanged, UNCALIBRATED conservative proxy; not learned model uncertainty
